user.title: Add RF Switch
user.description: Configure a 433 MHz radio outlet controlled via a GPIO transmitter.

dip.title: DIP Switch Configuration
dip.description: Enter the DIP switch settings from your outlet. System Code is 5 digits of 0/1 (e.g. {example_code}). Unit Code is the button letter (A–E).

direct.title: Direct Code Configuration
direct.description: Enter the decimal RF codes for ON and OFF. You can sniff these with `rpi-rf_receive` on the command line.

learn_on.title: Learn ON Code
learn_on.description: Press the ON button on your remote repeatedly, then click Submit. The receiver will capture the code automatically.

learn_off.title: Learn OFF Code
learn_off.description: Now press the OFF button on your remote repeatedly, then click Submit.

error.no_code_received: No code received. Make sure the receiver is connected correctly and try again.
error.rx_gpio_required: RX GPIO Pin is required for learn mode.
error.rx_same_as_tx: RX GPIO must be different from TX GPIO.

abort.no_rx_gpio: No RX GPIO configured. Please set an RX GPIO pin to use learn mode.
